#   function  file-scope function, static or VPRIV, used inside the diag module (and pp for the three pp files) only
#   public    declared in src/include/frontend/pp/pp.h (or ppimpl.h shared with other modules) and used by cc, codegen,
#             driver or server: touches other modules, so the script run edits them too (WORK-diag step 2/4)
#   type      struct, typedef or enum tag
#   field     struct field with a word name already or renamed to one; fields are renamed by whole word, so a
#             field is listed only when its name is not a one-letter or generic word
#   unsafe    a name a whole-word script cannot rename safely: one-letter fields (b, e, s, f, v, n, m, k) or
#             names that are also used for other things in the same files; rename by hand with the compiler's help

# sn_ls/lstart) they get distinct new names here and step 6 of the work order merges them.
# Checked: every old name occurs in src/ bench/ ci/ contrib/ (no stale row), no new name occurs there already and no two
# rows share a new name.  Rows of kind unsafe are commented out below, so that the script never applies them.
